topic: Can I post our date photo?
context: Monday 4 January, the first workday of the year: アルちゃん wants to put a photo from the {戸隠|とがくし} date on Instagram, but レン isn't out at work. He asks {健太|けんた} for advice on LINE.
scene: Monday lunchtime. You have a lovely photo of you and レン at {戸隠|とがくし}. Can you post it? You ask {健太|けんた}.

phrases.jp: {本人|ほんにん|the person themselves|3}に{聞いた|きいた}ほうがいいよ。
phrases.note: 〜たほうがいい: the everyday way to advise. {本人|ほんにん} = the person concerned.

phrases.jp: {写真|しゃしん}は{撮った|とった}ものの、まだ{載せて|のせて|to post, put up|3}いない。
phrases.en: I took the photos, but I haven't posted them yet.

phrases.jp: {設定|せってい|settings|3}で、{位置情報|いちじょうほう|location data|2}をオフにしてください。
phrases.en: Please turn off location in the settings.

phrases.jp: {無理|むり}に{投稿|とうこう|posting online|3}しなくてもいいんじゃない？
phrases.en: You don't have to post it if it doesn't feel right, do you?
phrases.note: 〜んじゃない？ softens advice into a suggestion.

phrases.jp: {買った|かった}ものの、{一度|いちど}も{使って|つかって}いません。
phrases.en: I bought it, but I haven't used it even once.

dialogue_setting: LINE, Monday lunchtime. You're in your room at the 田中 house; {健太|けんた} is at the guesthouse reception.

dialogue.speaker: アルちゃん
dialogue.jp: {健太|けんた}、{相談|そうだん}がある。{昨日|きのう}の{戸隠|とがくし}の{写真|しゃしん}、インスタに{載せたい|のせたい|to post, put up|3}んだけど…
dialogue.en: {健太|けんた}, I need advice. I want to put yesterday's {戸隠|とがくし} photos on Instagram, but…

dialogue.speaker: アルちゃん
dialogue.jp: レンと{二人|ふたり}で{撮った|とった}ものの、{投稿|とうこう|posting online|3}していいか{分からなくて|わからなくて}
dialogue.en: We took them together, but I don't know if it's OK to post them.

dialogue.speaker: 健太
dialogue.jp: おお、デートの{報告|ほうこく}か〜ｗ ええやん
dialogue.en: Ooh, a date report lol. Nice.
dialogue.note: ええやん = いいじゃない (Kansai).

dialogue.speaker: 健太
dialogue.jp: でもレン、{職場|しょくば|workplace|3}には{言うてへん|いうてへん}のやろ？{顔|かお}が{写ってる|うつってる|to appear (in a photo)|3}のはやめとき
dialogue.en: But レン hasn't told people at work, right? Skip the ones where his face shows.
dialogue.note: {言|い}うてへん = {言|い}っていない; やめとき = やめておきなさい (Kansai).

dialogue.speaker: 健太
dialogue.jp: {載せる|のせる|to post, put up|3}{前|まえ}に、{本人|ほんにん|the person themselves|3}に{聞いた|きいた}ほうがええで
dialogue.en: Ask him himself before you post.

dialogue.speaker: アルちゃん
dialogue.jp: そっか…{景色|けしき}だけにする。{位置情報|いちじょうほう|location data|2}も{消した|けした|to turn off, erase|4}ほうがいい？
dialogue.en: Right… I'll post just the scenery. Should I turn off the location too?

dialogue.speaker: 健太
dialogue.jp: うん、{田舎|いなか}はすぐ{噂|うわさ}になるからな。{設定|せってい|settings|3}でオフにしとき
dialogue.en: Yeah, rumours spread fast in the countryside. Switch it off in the settings.
dialogue.note: しとき = しておきなさい (Kansai).

dialogue.speaker: アルちゃん
dialogue.jp: レンに{聞いたら|きいたら}、「{後ろ姿|うしろすがた|someone seen from behind|3}ならいいよ」って！
dialogue.en: I asked レン: he said a shot from behind is fine!

dialogue.speaker: 健太
dialogue.jp: ほな{俺|おれ}、{一番|いちばん}に「いいね」{押す|おす}わ。{仕事|しごと}は{始まった|はじまった}ものの、{暇|ひま|free, not busy|4}やしｗ
dialogue.en: Then I'll be the first to hit 'like'. Work's started again, but it's dead here lol
dialogue.note: ほな = じゃあ; {暇|ひま}やし = {暇|ひま}だし (Kansai).

listening.intro: レン's reply, as a voice message.

lines.jp: {後ろ姿|うしろすがた|someone seen from behind|3}なら、{載せて|のせて|to post, put up|3}もいいよ。
lines.en: If it's from behind, you can post it.

grammar.form: verb: plain form + ものの ({撮|と}ったものの, {始|はじ}まったものの) · い-adj: + ものの ({安|やす}いものの) · な-adj: + なものの ({便利|べんり}なものの)
grammar.explanation: 'Although X, (things didn't go the expected way)'. The second half is often hesitation or a plan not carried out. Firmer and a bit more written than けど; unlike のに, it doesn't sound like a complaint.

examples.jp: ジムに{申し込んだ|もうしこんだ}ものの、まだ{一回|いっかい}も{行って|いって}いない。
examples.en: I signed up for the gym, but I haven't gone once.

examples.jp: このアプリは{便利|べんり}なものの、{電池|でんち}がすぐなくなる。
examples.en: This app is handy, but it drains the battery fast.

quiz.question: {写真|しゃしん}は{撮った|とった}＿＿、まだ{載せて|のせて|to post|3}いない。
quiz.en: I took the photos, but I haven't posted them yet.
quiz.explain: ものの joins 'I did X' with 'but not the next step'.

quiz_more.question: {仕事|しごと}は＿＿ものの、まだ{暇|ひま|free, not busy|4}だ。
quiz_more.en: Work has started, but it's still quiet.
quiz_more.explain: ものの follows the plain form: {始|はじ}まった.

quiz_more.question: {子|こ}どもの{頃|ころ}は、よく{雪|ゆき}で{遊んだ|あそんだ}＿＿。
quiz_more.en: As a kid, I used to play in the snow a lot.
quiz_more.explain: A fond past habit ends with ものだ; ものの needs a second clause.

kanji.where: On the Instagram screen, where アルちゃん saved the post before asking レン: 「{下書き|したがき}に{保存|ほぞん}しました」.
kanji.breakdown: {下書|したが}き: 下 under, before + 書き writing → the writing that comes before the final version: a draft.
kanji.related: {保存|ほぞん} = save; {削除|さくじょ} = delete.

tip.title: {顔出し|かおだし}NG
tip.body: Many people in Japan keep their face off social media, and friends blur or crop others before posting. {顔出し|かおだし}NG means 'no face shown, please'. Asking 「{載|の}せてもいい？」 before you post is normal good manners, not over-careful.

challenge.prompt: That evening, レン: 「{投稿|とうこう}{見た|みた}よ。{写真|しゃしん}、すごくいいね。{僕|ぼく}の{後ろ姿|うしろすがた}、かっこよすぎ？ｗ」 You're happy but a little embarrassed. Which sticker?
challenge.hint: Pleased and shy at the same time.
challenge.explanation: {恥|は}ずかしい… covers that shy, pleased feeling when someone teases you kindly. ガーン is shock, {怖|こわ}い… makes no sense, and お{疲|つか}れ{様|さま}です is a work greeting.

vocab.en: to post, put up (online); to put on
vocab.note: インスタに{載|の}せる. Same sound as {乗|の}せる (give a ride).
{職|しょく} job + {場|ば} place. {職場|しょくば}の{人|ひと} = colleagues.
For photos. Screens and reflections use {映|うつ}る.
{本人|ほんにん}{確認|かくにん} = ID check at banks and offices.
{電気|でんき}を{消|け}す, {写真|しゃしん}を{消|け}す. Intransitive: {消|き}える.
The ⚙ menu on any app. {設定|せってい}する = set up.
{後|うし}ろ behind + {姿|すがた} figure.
{暇|ひま}なとき = in your free time. Opposite: {忙|いそが}しい.

kanji_study.parts: 耳 ear + 音 sound + 戈 halberd → a guard with his ear tuned to orders and his weapon ready: someone doing their post, a job.
kanji_study.lookalike: Not 識 (knowledge): 識 has 言 words on the left; 職 has 耳 ear.

kanji_study.parts: 耳 ear + 又 hand → a hand grabbing an ear: in ancient battles, soldiers took an ear as proof. To take.
kanji_study.lookalike: Not 最 (most): 最 is 取 with 日 sun on top.
